role: Git-based screened dataset workflows — the network's direct source of qualified, cleansed datasets. PR-reviewed before ingestion; researcher/org-facing.

provides.surface: contributions/{contributor}/{dataset}/metadata.json + CSV/GeoJSON, validated against schemas/metadata.schema.json (GitHub Actions, scripts/validate-pr.mjs)
provides.note: Single validation authority for both the git-PR path and the on-prem field/gateway path (see docs/ingestion-paths.md). Qualified/cleansed; field/agent-authored readings stay quality_level: preliminary until reviewed.

consumes.expects: Commons-format water-quality CSV + metadata.json (contributor: manaolana) conforming to schemas/metadata.schema.json, submitted via Git PR to contributions/manaolana/ for the standard validate-pr screening.
consumes.note: Pairs with manaolana provides[].commons.water-quality. manaolana generates the export client-side (src/utils/water-testing-export.ts) today; PR submission into this repo is not yet wired (hence planned). Once a PR lands, the screened result flows on through provides[].research.contributions to node — manaolana is an upstream contributor, not a separate ingestion path.
